title: Label Propagation for Physics-Informed Neural Networks and Physics-Informed Gaussian Processes
abstract: arXiv:2404.05817v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We present a series of empirical results of the application of semi-supervised label propagation techniques in training physics-informed machine learning methods. This includes self-training of physics-informed neural networks and physics-informed Gaussian processes in isolation, and the integration of the two via co-training, therefore establishing a hybrid between these two main classes of physics-informed machine learning. We demonstrate via extensive numerical experiments how these methods can ameliorate the issue of propagating information from boundaries into the physical domain, including information from initial conditions in the case of solving stiff time-dependent partial differential equations, which is known to be a common failure mode of physics-informed machine learning.

translated_title: 用于物理信息神经网络与物理信息高斯过程的标签传播方法
translated_abstract: 我们呈现了一系列将半监督标签传播技术应用于训练物理信息机器学习方法的实证结果。这包括对物理信息神经网络和物理信息高斯过程分别进行自训练，以及通过协同训练将两者相结合，从而在这两大类物理信息机器学习方法之间建立了混合模型。我们通过大量数值实验展示了这些方法如何改善将信息从边界传播到物理域的问题，包括在求解刚性时间依赖偏微分方程时初始条件信息的传播问题，而这一问题被认为是物理信息机器学习中一种常见的失效模式。
tldr: 该论文将半监督标签传播技术应用于物理信息神经网络和物理信息高斯过程的训练，并通过协同训练建立两类方法的混合模型，有效缓解了信息难以从边界传播到物理域这一物理信息机器学习的常见失效问题。
en_tdlr: This paper applies semi-supervised label propagation techniques to train physics-informed neural networks and physics-informed Gaussian processes, establishing a hybrid of the two via co-training, which ameliorates the common failure mode of propagating boundary information into the physical domain in physics-informed machine learning.
